latest_release.name: VectorCraft v0.22.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Affinity import: bound archive index names and charge failed entry extraction by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5291
* Native format: document.save can write path coordinates at a fixed precision by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3990
* Drop invalid XML characters from SVG link URLs and aria-labels by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5279
* Fix #5312: EPS files written by Ghostscript's eps2write open by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5314
* Docs: file-format-parity keeps one .ai editing-data paragraph by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5269
* Type: Tate-chu-yoko offsets in character style definitions stay in range by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5259
* Document Info: Objects counts each object once by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5260
* PDF export: spot inks named All or None print as spot inks by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5250
* Type: an inline graphic takes its character's manual kerning by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5245
* Select: Same › Text Fill & Stroke Color selects type whose fill and stroke both match by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5244
* SVG: an exported ellipse imports as the four-anchor ellipse it was written from by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5243
* i18n(ru): translate the 130 strings the report listed as missing by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5240
* i18n(sv): translate the 22 strings the report listed as missing by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5242
* Geometry: a projective map's horizon and invertibility checks do not depend on its scale by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5271
* DXF export: bound curve flattening work and expanded symbol art by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5289
* Repeat: the instance budget counts opacity-mask art and the nodes each copy holds by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5290
* Page ranges: overlapping intervals skip indices already picked by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5292
* Depth limit: merge containers at the cap in one pass over the siblings by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5294
* Gradients: midpoints and freeform points find their stops by binary search by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5298
* Brush and symbol libraries: look definitions up by name by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5300
* Affinity import: count path segments and masks in master page copies; range-check vector masks by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5302
* Export for Screens: name patterns and taken names take linear work by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5304
* Affinity import: index the fields of large objects and read four rectangle corners by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5310
* Global Edit: a Shift-click on a highlighted match leaves it out of the edit by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5237
* Recolor Artwork: the Edit tab shows the colors on a smooth wheel, a segmented wheel or as color bars by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5249
* Symbols: 9-slice guides are shown and dragged on the canvas while editing a symbol by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5280
* Fix Simplified Chinese translation of Luminosity by @cybermaxwel in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/5329
* Brushes: leave out an opacity mask whose root symbol draws a brushed stroke by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/stor

detail.readme_excerpt:
VectorCraft

Vector illustration; an open-source, modern vector art application, built in pure Rust.

A fast, open-source vector illustration workflow. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly. Built by the ArtCraft team.
